raster.emulator:
openMSX 21.0
flavour: opt
components: CORE GL LASERDISC

calibration.source: openMSX RELEASE_21_0 src/video/VDP.cc and VDP.hh; installed _tas_tools.tcl
calibration.native_frame_epoch: machine_info VDP_cycle_in_frame, frame begins at VSYNC; no absolute-time modulo
calibration.vblank_definition: VDP status2 VR, checked against every endpoint; rising edge equals VSCAN IRQ edge

raster.method: Matched PC/SP routine entry/return breakpoints; original keyboard-only route until completion/game over; four warmup intervals discarded; native VDP clock snapshots and side-effect-free debug status2 reads
raster.limitations: Emulator only; routine endpoint includes descendants/interrupt time. clock_irq excludes hardware entry/vector. VBlank refers to VR, not a guaranteed safe VRAM budget. Line numbers start at physical VSYNC, not visible picture line zero. No actual original ROM or asset data exported.

schedule.method: Two-refresh readiness deadline measured from previous VBlank publication edge to wait_blank entry; actual publication classified with native VDP frame/tick counters. Self owners are disjoint within this instrumentation; inclusive maxima overlap and must not be added.

transition_probe.scope: All64x64 known transitions and64 cold starts, all physical pattern sets. Previous inactive slots seeded unknown. Exact current active glyph bytes and full128KiB VRAM guards; inactive HUD bytes may retain old or receive current source during gap merging. Current phase mapping/IFF preserved. IRQs enabled/exercised across probe, not inside every call. Wrapper timing includes IRQs; no gameplay FPS claim.

live_probe.scope: Keyboard route through native game over, HUD/audio/3 enemies. Every render compares all visible terrain/HUD/boundary/radar pattern/color bytes before/after; the active set is excluded from cache selection. Emulator only.

phase_cache_proof.placement: Foreground: select an inactive exact phase or next victim, update its HUD/boundary/radar. VBlank: publish R4/R10 and existing name/SAT registers. Native logic, input clock, audio and graphics payloads unchanged.
phase_cache_proof.limitations: First-stage keyboard route and synthetic phase transitions in openMSX; no physical hardware or later-phase validation. No stable zero-miss claim.

video_modes.scope: 60Hz mode measured above.50Hz figures calculated from official313-line timing constants, not a50Hz runtime run. Same CPU clock per second; native tick/audio adaptation would be required.

packet_transfer.scope: Inclusive transfer entry-to-return elapsed cycles including wait states. SCREEN4 display on, CPU interrupts enabled, VDP interrupt generation disabled for isolated timing and enabled for mixed-size chained packet cases. Every case compares all128KiB VRAM, final BC/HL/DE and preserved IFF, both R14 table sets and14-bit destination rollover. No mapper changes or integrated gameplay claim.
